_readme: Copy to config.json and edit. server.py does that for you on first run. The live config.json is not tracked: the dashboard writes card_order and favorites back to it as you drag and pin.
_socket: Unix sockets, not ports: loopback TCP is reachable by other accounts and, under WSL2, by every Windows process. tailscale serve points at the first one.
_allow_logins: Tailnet logins allowed to use the dashboard AT ALL. The server refuses to start with this empty; replace the placeholder with your own login.
_hosts: Optional. Host names to accept besides loopback and *.ts.net; anything else is refused (DNS rebinding).
_display_suffix: Per-machine postfix on card labels and /rc names, so pages from two machines are distinguishable. Folder names are never suffixed; the card label and the dtach socket carry it.
_folders: One Claude Code session per entry. A bare name resolves to src_dir/<name>. Use {path, name} for a repo nested inside another workspace, or when the card should not be called after the directory.
_fallback_model: Model for a session with no conversation to resume. Resumed sessions keep whatever they were on.
_clone: If a folder is missing, Start clones it first: clone_urls[name] if present, else clone_base/<name>.git
_file_roots: Optional. What the file viewer may serve, on top of each session's own folder. Default: src_dir and /tmp. $HOME and ~/.roost/pasted are always added.
_written_by_the_page: card_order and favorites appear here on their own once you drag or pin a card. Do not hand-edit them while the server is running.
_codex: Codex terminals are NOT configured here. They are ~/.dtach/<name>.cmd files: ./term.sh <name> 'cd ~/src/<repo> && codex'
